name: Queue Jump
summary: An invite code that bounces you over every head in the waitlist queue and through the door
about: A sunburst waitlist card with a cartoon queue of people standing in front of an Early Access door. Enter a friend's 8-character invite code and your pink figure bounces from head to head while the waitlist number rolls down, then the door opens and confetti pours out. Wrong and already-used codes each get their own rubber stamp and message.
how: Type or paste an 8-character invite code; the boxes act as one field with backspace and arrow keys
Or press one of the demo chips: NOOR-2611 works, ZAIN-1020 is already used
A full code is checked by itself, or press Skip the line
A valid code bounces you to the front and opens the door; press Back to the waitlist to start over
